entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry, we're closed for...

entries.speaker: Uptight Woman
entries.en: Sojiro Sakura, I presume?

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Man
entries.en: Our apologies for coming in so[n]late. We're investigators from[n]the domestic affairs court.

entries.speaker: Uptight Investigator
entries.en: We've received a report that one of[n]your customers was assaulted by the[n]probationer residing here.

entries.speaker: Uptight Investigator
entries.en: Moreover, this report stated that you are[n]abusing your child... Futaba-san.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: N-No... We didn't make it...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uncle sent his report to the[n]police before we could make[n]him have a change of heart...!

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: However, the anonymity of the report[n]has led us to question the validity[n]of its content. May we have a word?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Fine by me. I've got nothing to hide.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Please, take a seat.

entries.speaker: Uptight Investigator
entries.en: You're saying the report was[n]falsified?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's true that Futaba was living[n]as a shut-in, but she overcame that[n]weakness under her own power.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And... I would never abuse her.[n]She's like a daughter to me.

entries.speaker: Uptight Investigator
entries.en: And what about the assault claim?[n]His criminal record points to a[n]history of such violence...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You're wrong...!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The kid never laid a finger on[n]that guy. He just stood in the[n]way to try and protect Futaba.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: To be honest, [lName]-kun,[n]we looked into your current[n]reputation at school...

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: And it seems there have[n]been no issues whatsoever.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: Now then, it's our job to make[n]sure children like you are safe.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: How is it... living with Sakura-san?[n]Please, you can speak honestly.
It's great.[clr 27]
He's a bit of a nag.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well... there you have it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sheesh, brutal as ever.

entries.speaker: Uptight Investigator
entries.en: And what do you think, Futaba-san?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I... I'm okay.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I couldn't go out for a while...[n]but everyone helped me get better.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm not afraid anymore.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Th-That's why... I'm really[n]happy living with my d-dad!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Futaba...

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: ...I see.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: It's quite obvious there was no[n]truth to the report we received.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: I don't think we'll need to[n]schedule any additional check-ins[n]for [lName]-kun either.

entries.speaker: Uptight Investigator
entries.en: ...You sure about this?

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: Were they attempting to deceive us,[n]they wouldn't have been nearly so[n]earnest.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: Besides, meeting them only served to[n]reaffirm my suspicions... These children[n]are the real victims here.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: The truth of these things will be clearer to[n]you once you're a little more experienced.

entries.speaker: Mild-Mannered Investigator
entries.en: Anyway, thank you for your cooperation.[n]We'll see ourselves out.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro, we did it!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro?
Are you crying?
You have a great daughter.[clr 27]
Congrats.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't be stupid... I-I'm just[n]sweating, that's all.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh-huh, suuuuuuuuure.[n]Sweating from your eyes!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's not just her, idiot.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: There's another pretty important[n]person living here too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, yeah! He's talking[n]about you, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This really isn't like me...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oooh! Are you crying!?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sniff* This is 'cause you[n]punks just had to go and say[n]all that cheesy stuff...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It wasn't cheesy! It was the truth!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyways, I hungerrr! Gimme some curry!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Heh, so much for the sentimental moment.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: All right, sit your butts down.[n]This is where you two belong.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mweheh! C'mon, [fName]![n]It's time to eat!
I feel like my bond with[n]Sojiro is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, and uh... Futaba.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What you said before...[n]When you called me your dad...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Do you, um, think you[n]could say that again...?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that.[n]My stomach was too grumbly!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What'd you say?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, never mind...
